svg.title: L4 Rear - pin ladder
svg.text: One block per housing, one row per cavity. Every wire runs straight from its cavity to where it lands. Read left to right.
Grid G-25 terminal LG; grid terminal B → rear star ground (12 AWG)
Carter P4070 + ; pump − → its OWN 12 AWG to the rear star ground
L4-P-3 · 12 AWG RED · RT19 · capped at the far end
Lands at the sill node — the K5–K8 contact feed through the F8 / F9 holders, fitted empty (D-283); the
Mirror heat feed → sill (F14), switched by
L4-P-4 · 12 AWG RED · RT19 · capped at the far end
Lands at the sill node in F14's holder, fitted empty (D-283) — this branch's end (D-274). Fed from the
DCU's high-side mirror-heat switch through DP-DCU-B 9 (D-369, as D-254 meant), no longer the O15
Splice at the hatch → F-07 RG, F-08 RG, F-04 RG (×2), F-14 RG, F-15 RG
L4-M-3 · 14 AWG ORN · RT18 · capped at the far end
The hatch-release solenoid's + terminal, through the hinge loop with the tail-lamp conductors — it
exists and is believed to work (Camden 2026-09-08, DV48); the post end is capped until the luxury
package fits the trigger (D-180; the K3 / K4 sockets are the slot) (D-274)
L4-M-4 · 14 AWG ORN · capped at the far end
The fuel-door solenoid's + terminal behind the quarter trim — it exists (Camden 2026-09-08, DV49;
K-017 corrected); the post end is capped until the trigger (D-180) (D-274)
Interior/spot lamp H-06 +; lamp − through its own DOOR/OFF/ON switch → roof-rail ground
Window DRV up command → K5 coil
L4-M-9 · 16 AWG BLU · RT19 · capped at the far end
K5 socket, terminal 86 at the sill node — landed in the empty socket, which is this branch's end; the
relay comes with the power windows (D-274)
Window DRV down command → K6 coil
L4-M-10 · 16 AWG BLU · RT19 · capped at the far end
K6 socket, terminal 86 at the sill node — landed in the empty socket, which is this branch's end; the
relay comes with the power windows (D-274)
Window PASS up command → K7 coil
L4-M-11 · 16 AWG BLU · RT19 · capped at the far end
K7 socket, terminal 86 at the sill node — landed in the empty socket, which is this branch's end; the
relay comes with the power windows (D-274)
Window PASS down command → K8 coil
L4-M-12 · 16 AWG BLU · RT19 · capped at the far end
K8 socket, terminal 86 at the sill node — landed in the empty socket, which is this branch's end; the
relay comes with the power windows (D-274)
Tank sender C-01 terminal Y; sender terminal B → rear star ground (16 AWG). Route apart from L4-P
47 kΩ baseline from the sill splice to the sill ground, so all-doors-shut reads 47k and open means a
break (D-368). Splice at the sill → driver jamb switch through 33 kΩ · passenger jamb switch through
8.2 kΩ; each switch grounds through its body
Pulse generator on the transmission's speedo-drive boss (DV47, P113), fitted at the meters cutover —
signal; 18 in service loop in the tunnel (D-272)
Road speed — pulse generator supply +12 V
Pulse generator supply — an O10 tap (N73), so the sensor lives and dies with the ICU; sensor ground
L4-S-5 · 16 AWG GRY · RT15 · capped at the far end
L4-RDR 1 — the pass-through's rear-end receptacle at the rear node, dust-capped; the run up the
hatch goes in with the sensor (D-274)
L4-S-6 · 16 AWG GRY · RT15 · capped at the far end
L4-RDR 2 — the pass-through's rear-end receptacle at the rear node, dust-capped; the run up the
hatch goes in with the sensor (D-274)
L4-S-7 · 16 AWG GRY · RT15 · capped at the far end
L4-RDR 3 — the pass-through's rear-end receptacle at the rear node, dust-capped; the run up the
hatch goes in with the sensor (D-274)
Luggage lamp H-11 +; lamp − → lid switch H-12 → rear star ground
L4-S2-1 · 16 AWG GRY · RT19 · capped at the far end
Capped at the post, on the DCU's line from L3-S3 (D-360); at the sill node spliced to D1 4 and D2 4
(D-255). Pin function inside the door is confirm - W-332
L4-S2-2 · 16 AWG GRY · RT19 · capped at the far end
Capped at the post, on the DCU's line from L3-S3 (D-360); sill node → D1 5 (D-255). Pin function inside
L4-S2-3 · 16 AWG GRY · RT19 · capped at the far end
Capped at the post, on the DCU's line from L3-S3 (D-360); sill node → D1 6 (D-255). Pin function inside
L4-S2-4 · 16 AWG GRY · RT19 · capped at the far end
Capped at the post, on the DCU's line from L3-S3 (D-360); sill node → D2 5 (D-255). Pin function inside
L4-S2-5 · 16 AWG GRY · RT19 · capped at the far end
Capped at the post, on the DCU's line from L3-S3 (D-360); sill node → D2 6 (D-255). Pin function inside
Sealing plug, size 16 - the master-switch position sense is dropped and its conductor is not run
(D-351, supersedes D-331). Camden: he is the only future owner, he will not open the master with the
engine running, and he will not dig the tunnel up to add a wire he declined
Kick-down solenoid B-33 on the transmission. Shares the RT21 tunnel run with the road-speed pair;
the solenoid's other side is its factory ground on the case
reserved - no wire in the leg
Pinned on the node side of the sill receptacle; sealing plug in the door plug — the door harness is
built with the mirror and the window (D-274)

L4-RDR-1 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
Dust-capped receptacle at the rear node — the run up the hatch to the sensor goes in with it (D-274)
L4-RDR-2 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
L4-RDR-3 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
Solid wire: live. Dashed: run and capped at the far end. A box on a wire is an inline resistor. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
